title: Auditing Gender Presentation Differences in Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting text-to-image models with gender-specific indicators (e.g., 'a woman', 'a man') in neutral and explicit contexts, and then quantifying the frequency differences of fine-grained, presentation-centric attributes (such as clothing and accessories) in the generated images. The evaluation is done using human annotations and automated cross-modal classifiers (CLIP-based) to calculate the proposed Gender Presentation Differences (GEP) metric. It also extends this methodology to measure occupational gender stereotypes by comparing the generated presentation attributes of gender-specified versus gender-unspecified professions.
